verdict.rationale: Netlify documents deploying to a global CDN and building serverless functions. Its integrations directory also describes Turso as bringing data 'close to your edge functions', which implies Netlify runs code at the edge, and one community user praises Netlify's 'edge products'. However, no first-party doc describes executing user code on edge nodes near end users; the global CDN claim covers deployed projects, not code execution. missing for 10: first-party Edge Functions documentation, evidence that serverless/edge code runs in globally distributed locations near users, runtime/region details, independent hands-on corroboration of edge execution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my code on a global edge network close to end users
